perk.name: Community Roots
perk.text: Collect an extra $50 every time you pass GO.

perk.name: Commuter Belt
perk.text: Gain 1 extra Momentum token when you pass GO. Your token limit goes up by 2.

perk.name: Arts District
perk.text: When you draw an Opportunity card, draw 2 and keep 1. Your hand limit becomes 4.

perk.name: Neighborhood Watch
perk.text: Any opponent in Jail or recovering from the Hospital pays you $25 at the start of each of their turns there.

perk.name: Hostile Takeover
perk.text: Once per lap, force an auction on one eligible opponent property.

perk.name: Bank Partner
perk.text: Your loans cost $210 to repay instead of $250, and you can hold 3 instead of 2.

perk.name: Dividends
perk.text: At the start of each of your turns, collect $20 for every hotel or skyscraper you own.

perk.name: Prime Real Estate
perk.text: Immune to negative rent modifiers. Skyscraper levels cost 1 x house cost.
